character.name: LÖLBERT
character.background: Paladin — Ash-Sworn survivor and oathbound avenger
traits: Orcish Brutality: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (2) once per short rest.
Elven Serenity: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.
Nature's Blessing: Once per long rest, call upon tree, wind, water, or mountain spirits to gain advantage on one Strength or Constitution check.
Lay on Hands: You have a pool of 5 healing hit points; touch restores hit points, or spends the full pool to cure one disease or poison.
character.gear: Rune-Scarred Greatsword · Ash-Walker Chain Mail · Healing Draught · Dried Boar Strips ×3 · Oath-Stone Amulet · Grave-Ash Bedroll · Flint and Tinderbox · Whetstone of the First Camp
character.story: LÖLBERT was born beneath a storm-wind to an orc warleader and an elven healer, raised by the Ash-Sworn tribe that called loyalty its highest law. Young, yet blood-tested, he learned blade and prayer beneath speaking trees. While he hunted, occult sorcerers drowned his village in black flame. Returning to silence, he buried every kinfolk, raised a stone monument with his bare hands, and swore an oath. Now he follows the old prophecy: a mixed warrior of light upon a griffon, bearing rune-carved steel. He seeks revenge, purpose, a home, and something worthy to protect.

inventory.name: Rune-Scarred Greatsword
inventory.lore: Raised from the ash of your burned home with your mother's last blessing; its mountain-script glows faintly when occult fire is near.
inventory.description: A prophecy-marked greatsword, its blade etched with old tribal runes and darkened by funeral smoke.

inventory.name: Ash-Walker Chain Mail
inventory.lore: Forged for your father's warband by captive mountain-smiths; each ring was quenched in river water blessed by elven singers.
inventory.description: A heavy suit of blackened chain mail, still bearing the dents of your tribe's last stand.

inventory.name: Healing Draught
inventory.lore: Mixed by your mother from moonthistle and springwater before the fire; it still smells faintly of her garden.
inventory.description: A pale green healing potion sealed with wax and a strand of elven hair.

inventory.name: Dried Boar Strips
inventory.lore: Smoked over sacred juniper by the tribe's fire-keeper, these rations were meant for your coming-of-age hunt.
inventory.description: Tough strips of preserved boar meat wrapped in bark.

inventory.name: Oath-Stone Amulet
inventory.lore: A river-stone carved with the griffon prophecy, worn by every first-born of your bloodline until the night the village burned.
inventory.description: A smooth gray amulet etched with wings, runes, and a rising sun.
inventory.effects: Can be used as a holy symbol. Once per long rest, when you pray over it, you sense the presence of fiends or undead within 30 feet for 1 minute.

inventory.name: Grave-Ash Bedroll
inventory.lore: Stitched from funeral cloths and wolf hide, it carries a pinch of ash from the monument you raised.
inventory.description: A dark traveling bedroll that smells of smoke, pine, and old rain.

inventory.name: Flint and Tinderbox
inventory.lore: Taken from the ruins of the elder's longhouse; its flint is said to spark truer when lit in honor of the dead.
inventory.description: A small iron striker, flint, and dry tinder kept in a charred wooden box.

inventory.name: Whetstone of the First Camp
inventory.lore: Your father carried this stone when the tribe first settled beneath the singing cliffs; it sharpens blades and memory alike.
inventory.description: A coarse gray whetstone worn smooth by generations of warriors.
